K-A.text: Build kit A: a large red brick in slot 1, a small blue brick in slot 2, a large yellow brick in slot 3 and a small red brick in slot 4.

K-B.text: Build kit B: a large blue brick in slot 1 with a small blue brick on top, a large red brick in slot 2, a large yellow brick in slot 3 with a small red brick on top and slot 4 empty.

K-C.text: Build kit C: a small red brick in slot 1, a large red brick in slot 2, a small yellow brick in slot 3 and a large yellow brick in slot 4.

K-A-B.text: Change the tray from kit A to kit B: a large blue brick in slot 1 with a small blue brick on top, a large red brick in slot 2, a large yellow brick in slot 3 with a small red brick on top and slot 4 empty. Put the bricks that are not needed in the return position.

K-A-C.text: Change the tray from kit A to kit C: a small red brick in slot 1, a large red brick in slot 2, a small yellow brick in slot 3 and a large yellow brick in slot 4. Put the bricks that are not needed in the return position.

K-B-A.text: Change the tray from kit B to kit A: a large red brick in slot 1, a small blue brick in slot 2, a large yellow brick in slot 3 and a small red brick in slot 4. Put the bricks that are not needed in the return position.

K-B-C.text: Change the tray from kit B to kit C: a small red brick in slot 1, a large red brick in slot 2, a small yellow brick in slot 3 and a large yellow brick in slot 4. Put the bricks that are not needed in the return position.

K-C-A.text: Change the tray from kit C to kit A: a large red brick in slot 1, a small blue brick in slot 2, a large yellow brick in slot 3 and a small red brick in slot 4. Put the bricks that are not needed in the return position.

K-C-B.text: Change the tray from kit C to kit B: a large blue brick in slot 1 with a small blue brick on top, a large red brick in slot 2, a large yellow brick in slot 3 with a small red brick on top and slot 4 empty. Put the bricks that are not needed in the return position.
